5.text: and having a family. “It is more convenient thus,” was the answer of every

7.text: Marriages among the Reindeer Chukchee, as will be shown further on,

8.text: are concluded at every age, from very tender infancy up to the full-grown

9.text: adult. Their ideal of a bride includes, in the first place, physical strength
